item.title: Shuxian Jin
item.description:
Dr. Shuxian Jin is a postdoctoral research fellow at the School of Psychology, University of Sussex. She received her PhD in Social Psychology from the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam in 2023. Her research interests concern how different cultural settings, socio-ecological conditions, and patterns of interdependence (e.g., conflict of interests) shape cooperation, norms and institutional choices, and how institutional solutions promote cooperation. She applies meta-analysis, online and lab-based behavioral experiments, and cross-societal surveys to test theories of cooperation. Her work has been published or recently accepted in journals such as Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, Journal of Experimental Social Psychology, and Nature Human Behaviour.

Personal website: https://profiles.sussex.ac.uk/p580540-shuxian-jin
